definitions.explanation: The systematic study of the natural world through observation and experimentation.

examples.japanese: {科学|かがく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}した→進歩する：03265_shinpo⟧。
⟦{科学者|かがくしゃ}→科学者：19378_kagakusha⟧⟦になりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become a scientist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{科学的|かがくてき}→科学的：05677_kagakuteki⟧な⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧

notes:
{科学|かがく} refers to science in general or the natural sciences specifically. It covers the systematic study of the natural world through observation and experimentation.

HOMOPHONE:
{化学|かがく} also reads as かがく but means 'chemistry.' To avoid confusion, {化学|かがく} is sometimes read as ばけがく in spoken Japanese.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {科学者|かがくしゃ}: scientist
- ⟦{科学的|かがくてき}→科学的：05677_kagakuteki⟧: scientific
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{科学|かがく}: natural science
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧{科学|かがく}: social science
- {科学|かがく}{技術|ぎじゅつ}: science and technology
